item.title: Copper Country Intermediate School District holds inaugural CTE ‘Pike Tank’ marketing event
item.description: The Copper Country Intermediate School District has brought the popular tv show 'Shark Tank' to freshwater. On Tuesday morning after months of preparations, around 40 CTE high school students from Baraga, Keweenaw and Houghton counties brought their business projects to life through presentations, before receiving feedback from a panel of 'Pikes.'
